bands.description: [from, to, colour] with from/to as fractions of the polygon's height.

aspect.description: Aspect ratio as positive integers [width, height], for example [4, 5].

oneOf.description: Sample the target image.
Pick from the style's `colors`.

ColorSpec.description:
A colour: `"#rrggbb"`, a tube name (for example `"lead_white"`, `"cobalt_blue"`), an sRGB triple with channels in
[0, 1], or `["a", "b", t]`, a mix of two colours at t in [0, 1] made with the active mixer.

softness.description: 0 = hard edge; otherwise the width of the fade, relative to the radius.

FieldDecl.description:
A sampled field: little-endian f32 values (1 channel for a mask, 2 for a flow, 3 for rgb), row-major, passed next
to the spec and checked against `sha256`.

gradientV.description: A vertical gradient: stops [y, colour], linear between them, clamped outside.

Fit.description: How a picture of another aspect ratio fills the canvas.

oneOf.description: Scale to cover the whole canvas and crop the overflow, centred.
Scale to fit inside the canvas, centred; outside it the target is unchanged.
Stretch to the canvas, ignoring the picture's aspect ratio.

Flow.description: A unit direction field, as a single-key object.

oneOf.description: Long arcs: base direction plus a slowly varying bend.
Near-horizontal with an undulation whose wavelength shrinks toward the horizon.
Tangential flow around ellipse centres [cx, cy, rx, ry].
Tangent of a polygon's distance field: strokes follow its outline.
A sampled flow (escape hatch), by name.

field.description: Name of an rgb field in `fields` (sRGB in [0, 1]).

Layer.description:
A layer of the schedule. Besides its own keys it accepts every style key, overriding the region styles for this
layer.

align.description: 1 = strictly along the flow, 0 = random directions (default 0.85).

blob.description: Extra paint where the stroke starts, x hgain (default 0.3).

coverage.description: Share of the region to cover: a number or per region (regions not listed: 1.0).

curvature.description: 0 = straight, 1 = follows every turn of the flow (default 0.3).

curve.description: Curve placement: per region, "boundary" or a polyline (regions not listed, or no map: "boundary").

dabShare.description: 0..1: share of strokes that are short dabs, one to `minAspect` widths long (default 0).

dryAfter.description: Wetness factor applied after the layer.

dryThresh.description: Scumble: height-above-blur threshold where paint catches (default 0).

endWidth.description: Width factor at the stroke's end (default 0.5).

errorThreshold.description: Lab error that triggers a stroke (error placement; v1 `T`).

flatten.description: Share of the surface the stroke replaces (default 0.6).

flick.description: 0..1: share of strokes that end in a flick, a curl of up to 40 degrees over the last third (default 0).

furrow.description: Trough along the centre, x hgain (default 0.15).

gridFactor.description: Proposal grid cell in stroke widths (v1 `fg`).

hblurSigma.description: Height blur before scumble, in cw.

lFloor.description: Stroke colours are never darker than this L* (default 0; the impressionist preset sets 20).

length.description: Stroke length range [min, max] in cw (default [0.04, 0.10]).

lengthSkew.description: >= 0: skews stroke lengths toward the short end of `length` (default 0: uniform).

levee.description: Raised paint along both edges, x hgain (default 0.35).

load.description: Paint on the brush at the start (default 1.0).

load2.description: Colour B for marbling (default: a lighter/warmer variant).

marble.description: Two-colour load: share of colour B in its lanes (default 0).

maxCover.description: Skip sites already covered more than this.

minAspect.description: Length >= minAspect x width unless the layer sets `dab` (default 2.5).

mode.description: paint, scumble, smudge or glaze (default paint).

nbPerCw.description: Bristle lanes = nbBase + nbPerCw x width (default 450).

opacityByLight.description: Fade strokes away from the light: opacity x (1 - k (1 - light)) (default 0).

pickup.description: Share of wet paint picked up from the canvas (default 0.12).

priority.description: Order among regions within a layer, low first (default 0).

referenceBlur.description: Blur of the reference in stroke widths (v1 `fs`).

reliefByValue.description:
0..1: paint thickness follows the colour's value, thick in the lights and thin in the darks
(default 0).

reverseP.description: Chance to run against the flow (default 0).

sizeByDetail.description:
0..1: stroke width follows the reference's local detail, narrower where it is busy and wider where it
is flat, within `width` (default 0: uniform in the range).

sizeByY.description: [y0, y1, s0, s1]: scale width and length by s0 at y0 .. s1 at y1 (perspective).

snap.description: Pull toward the nearest palette mixture (default 0.85).

spacing.description: Density placement spacing in stroke widths: a number or per region (regions not listed: 1.6).

spill.description: Chance to keep painting across a region edge (default 0.15).

stiff.description: Multi-scale roughness of stiff paint, x hgain (default 0.25).

stopAtEdge.description: Chance to stop where the soft mask fades (default 0.9).

vdry.description: How fast the tail dries out (default 0.25).

warmth.description: How much the light map warms the colour toward warmColor (default 0).

width.description: Stroke width range [min, max] in cw (default [0.015, 0.03]).

Light.description: A light-map contribution, as a single-key object.

oneOf.description: An ellipse of light, 2.5x flatter than wide.

scale.description: Size of the largest noise feature, in cw.

NumOrMap.description: A number for all regions, or one per region name.

oneOf.description: Where the canvas differs most from the target.
Even coverage at `spacing`.
Along given curves (`curve`).

flow.description: Stroke direction field; without one the region follows the target's structure tensor.

RegionSel.description: `"all"` or a list of region names.

Shape.description: A mask in [0, 1], as a single-key object.

oneOf.description: Everywhere (`{"all": true}`).

Sum of the shapes, clamped to 1.
Product of the shapes.
1 - shape.
A shape whose boundary is perturbed by noise.

description:
A ScenePlan: the declarative description of a painting. With the plan options `{seed, planWidth, mixer}` and an
engine version it determines the StrokeList bit for bit on every host.

$schema.description: Ignored by the engine; lets editors validate.

engine.description: Engine version the scene was authored and tuned with. A different engine warns (`ENGINE_VERSION_DIFFERS`).

fields.description: Declarations of sampled fields (escape hatch): the arrays are passed next to the spec.

layers.description: The layer schedule, painted in order.

lights.description: Contributions to the light map (drives `warmth` and `opacityByLight`).

preset.description:
A style preset (for example `"impressionist"`): its style values sit between the engine's neutral defaults and
the region styles.

regions.description: Regions, in order: later regions override earlier ones in the hard region map.

styles.description: Style per region, keyed by region name.

target.description: Target-image operations, applied in order: the reference colours the planner paints toward.
